components.name: Input
components.summary:
A one-line text field, in fifteen looks, with the extras forms need: a clear
button, a counter, a copy button, add-ons, an inline action. Put it in a Field
for its label, hint and error (or use floating, notched or inline, which draw
the label inside). A password field has a button that shows what was typed.

props.name: variant
props.description:
outline: a bordered box (the default). filled: a grey fill and a line that thickens on focus.
underline: only a bottom line, for dense forms. cupertino: iOS's grey rounded field. pill:
fully rounded, for search. ghost: no box until hovered, for editing in place. floating: filled,
the label inside rising as you type. notched: outlined, the label rising onto the border.
soft: a brand tint. inset: sunken. elevated: a shadow instead of a border. bold: a 2px border.
dashed: a dashed border, for optional or draft values. minimal: a line only on hover and focus.
inline: the label inside on the left, for settings rows.

props.name: size
props.description: sm in tables and toolbars, md by default, lg on sign-in and other short forms.

props.name: label

props.name: trailing

props.name: addonBefore

props.name: addonAfter
props.description: Joined to the field's right as a grey block: ".com", a unit.

props.name: action
props.description: A small button inside, at the right: Apply (a coupon), Verify, Send.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A cross that empties the field, shown once there's text.

components.name: PaletteStyle
components.summary:
Applies a palette, light and dark, as a <style> tag: put it in the root
layout. One of preset, seed or palette; the neutral palette if none.

props.name: preset
props.description: A ready-made palette by name: "navy", "forest", "midnight"… (palettePresets).

props.name: seed
props.description: Or seeds to make one from: { brand, accent, chrome, neutral }.

props.name: palette
props.description: Or a palette already made with createPalette.

props.name: selector
props.description: Where it applies: the whole app (":root") or a part of it ("[data-palette=ocean]").
